one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 对话框连接 GitHub，并让 AI 调用 REST API。
one_liner.en: Connect GitHub to DSH and let the assistant call its REST API.

accounts: GitHub account; OAuth device flow requires the user’s own OAuth App Client ID, or connect with a personal access token.

external_services.purpose: OAuth device authorization and token exchange

local: Stores credentials in DSH home at .dsh-github-connect/auth.json by default; authFile can override the path.
